description: Weekly X Champion belt lineage — the league's signature mechanic. Week 1 crowns the highest-scoring team; every week after, the holder forces one FLEX-eligible player into their opponent's starting lineup (sabotage), declared in league chat by Friday 11:59 PM CT. The belt transfers to whoever beats the holder. A waived lock is logged on that matchup week with no sabotage. Nothing else — not Sleeper, not Flaim — tracks this, which is why this file exists.

weeks.notes: WK1 CROWN ONLY. Official chat drop 2026-09-15: THE FIRST ❌ CHAMP IS CROWNED: @Nels8951. Week 1 league-high 189.8 PPR (beat Maxwellhiggens 189.8–129.3). Runner-up anyfoolwilldo 189.5. No sabotage in the crown week. Belt carries into Week 2.

Nels holds. FIRST X LOCK declared 2026-09-18 before Friday 11:59 PM CT: Blake Corum (RB LAR, sleeper 11586) locked into @trappat FLEX. RESULT: lost to @trappat 124.2–128.52. Corum 10.2 PPR on MNF. Title change chat drop 2026-09-21.

Commish confirm: '@trappat go ahead and lock him in @anyfoolwilldo'. Hill already in the starting FLEX at lock time. RESULT: held 143.92–105.78. Hill 3.3 PPR (5 att, 33 rush yds, 0 rec). LC wrap 2026-09-28: AND STILL / reigning defending ❌ Champ.
